findings.title: The no-fee claim has no number behind it

location.description: the intro under the headline that says there is no fee on top of the hire

findings.viewer_experience: The visitor reads "no fee on top of the hire" but has no price to judge it against, so the page's main selling point stays unproven.

current.value: the intro makes the no-fee claim with no price or other boatyard fact near it or near the form

findings.target: a fact that proves the claim sits near the intro or the form
findings.fix_direction: Show a fact that proves the claim near the intro or the form, such as a from-price per week for a boat at this base. Only the boatyard can supply that figure; the maker must supply it.

closed_when.check: In the desktop, phone, tablet and widescreen images, a price or other boatyard fact that backs the no-fee claim is visible near the intro or the form.

findings.title: A holiday page with no picture of the holiday

location.description: the hero, which is only headline and intro

findings.viewer_experience: People hire a narrowboat for the boat and the water, and the page shows neither, so it sells a form instead of a trip.

current.value: the hero is only headline and intro, with no photo of a boat or a route

findings.target: a real photo of the boatyard's own boats or of a listed route in the hero
findings.fix_direction: Add a real photo of the boatyard's own boats or of a listed route, not a stock picture. The boatyard must supply it.

closed_when.check: In the desktop, phone, tablet and widescreen images, the hero shows a real photo of a boat or a route.

findings.title: The start-date field has no date-picker cue

location.description: the Start date field in the Find a boat form

findings.viewer_experience: The visitor cannot tell the field wants a picked date.

current.value: a plain box that holds "Sat 14 June", with no calendar icon or other cue to pick a date

findings.target: the field shows a cue that a date is picked
findings.fix_direction: Use a date input or add a calendar icon to the field.

closed_when.check: In the desktop, phone, tablet and widescreen images, the start-date field shows a calendar icon or other date-picker cue.

findings.title: On the tablet the form fields are very long for short values

location.description: the Nights field in the Find a boat form on the tablet

findings.viewer_experience: A value like "7 nights" sits in a field 594 px wide.
findings.target: Nights and Berths side by side on one row, or a capped width for the form card
findings.fix_direction: Put Nights and Berths side by side on one row, or cap the width of the form card.

closed_when.check: the width of form.search > label:nth-of-type(3) > select in the tablet viewport is less than 594, or Nights and Berths share one row
